SELECT SEQ_CONSULT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_CONSULT (CONSULT_ID, MEMBER_ID, LAWYER_ID, CASE_ID, CONSULT_DATE, DURATION_MIN, NOTE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{consultId}, #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lawyerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{caseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_DATE(#{consultDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), #{durationMin}, #{note}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT c.CONSULT_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.CASE_ID, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS CONSULT_DATE, c.DURATION_MIN, c.NOTE, c.STATUS, c.REJECT_REASON, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT, m.NAME AS LAWYER_NAME, l.CONSULT_FEE AS CONSULT_FEE FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON l.LAWYER_ID = c.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.CONSULT_ID = #{consultId}

SELECT c.CONSULT_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.CASE_ID, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONSULT_DATE, c.DURATION_MIN, c.NOTE, c.STATUS, c.REJECT_REASON, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT, m.NAME AS LAWYER_NAME, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TB_REVIEW r WHERE r.CONSULT_ID = c.CONSULT_ID AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS REVIEWED FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON l.LAWYER_ID = c.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT c.CONSULT_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.CASE_ID, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONSULT_DATE, c.DURATION_MIN, c.NOTE, c.STATUS, c.REJECT_REASON, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT, m.NAME AS LAWYER_NAME, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TB_REVIEW r WHERE r.CONSULT_ID = c.CONSULT_ID AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS REVIEWED FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON l.LAWYER_ID = c.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND c.STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT c.CONSULT_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, c.CASE_ID, TO_CHAR(c.CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONSULT_DATE, c.DURATION_MIN, c.NOTE, c.STATUS, c.REJECT_REASON, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} ORDER BY c.CONSULT_DATE DESC
SELECT TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_ID = #{consultId}
UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_ID = #{consultId}
UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET STATUS = 'PENDING', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONSULT_ID = #{consultId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_CONSULT WHERE STATUS = 'CANCELLED' AND UPDATED_AT < SYSDATE - 7
mapper.select: SELECT LAWYER_ID FROM TB_LAWYER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CONSULT SET STATUS = 'DONE', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND CONSULT_DATE < SYSDATE
